basket.law: Fixed saved opportunities on shared observed sessions. At most one position. Earliest entry first, with higher weight and then basket order breaking ties. An entry at a prior exit is allowed after the exit. Positions and signals are not rerun. Saved net costs and adverse marks are scaled linearly to whole MNQ. Funded tiers cap each admitted member target at the session opening tier.

members.risk_basis: MultiCharts modeled OHLC path excursions restricted to entry-through-exit, including entry and realized exit costs once. These are model estimates, not measured tick MAE/MFE or confidence bounds. Opening gaps and cost jumps can overshoot floors; intervening modeled crossings use the threshold price. Unobserved tick gaps, liquidity and queue effects are not reconstructed.
members.session_convention: Common observed CME session labels, including no-trade sessions.
